The 320GB HDD provides convenient storage for documents, business files, educational content, photos, videos, and other everyday data. This assembled desktop PC comes ready for use with an operating system and MS Office pre-installed, helping users get started with their regular computing tasks without complicated software installation. For flexible display connectivity, the computer supports both HDMI and VGA outputs, making it suitable for connecting compatible modern HDMI monitors as well as older VGA displays.
